sha256_basis: committed git blob content (LF-normalized); checkouts with core.autocrlf=true may show CRLF bytes - verify with `git show <commit>:<path> | sha256sum`
correctness_review: High 0 / Medium 0 / Low 0 (rev 4 review H1 M8 L8 -> 3 re-review rounds)
next_required: IMPLEMENTATION FREEZE (prereg §18-B) before any live Stage 1 session; implementation and live runs need separate user approval
change_rule: No edits to the prereg after this freeze; defects require a new revision plus a replacement manifest with `supersedes` (prereg §18)
